request: Lower the goal to 96 because 120 was more than I can realistically hit on the road, and I would rather start from a number I can reach.
Could the app be called My Tracker now? The old name Revise Next made me think of exams, and I use it to log my daily work instead.
Let the budget begin at 75000 instead of 50000, since that is roughly what I spend each month now, and it saves me entering it again.
I want the theme grey now, because the plum looked too loud next to my other apps and grey keeps the screen calm for me.
The goal should start at 48000 rather than 60000, because that matches the number my clinic has agreed on, and it makes the first screen more accurate.
Could the theme go grey instead of ocean? The blue is hard to read in the sun and grey keeps the numbers clear on my phone.
Make the target 66 by default, not 33, since I have found that 66 is the figure that actually keeps the batches moving through the shop.
Rename the app to Pulse because it is about how I feel each day, and the old name Sit-ups only covered the exercise part of it.
I would like the app called My Corner, since it is where I keep the farm notes for myself, and Farm Accounts sounds too much like a bank.
Could the name become Daybook? It is a diary of my school van trips, so the name should say it is a daily record and not a vehicle thing.
The rate should begin at 32 instead of 40, since that is the amount I charge most of my regular clients, and I want it right from the start.
I think Pocket Planner is a better name for the app, because I use it to plan my car costs each month and the name should show that.
Could the theme be orange, not ocean? I find that orange is easier to see when I am checking the route on a long drive.
Pocket Planner would be a good name now, since the app helps me split the power bill with my neighbours every month and the old name never said that.
Please turn the app into dark mode, because I check my accounts late at night and the white screen wakes my whole house up.
The budget should start at 4500 rather than 3000, because my farm costs went up this season and I want the starting figure to match that.
